classification: Isolated synthetic FRRN -> Unanym -> real WordPress rehearsal; no real mail, mandate or member acceptance
checks: WordPress administrator connects the issuer, recognises an organisation and selects a private members page using forms.
Pending FRRN application supplies no shareable membership; signing in alone cannot open the WordPress page.
One organiser approval in FRRN reaches Unanym only after member consent, and opens the actual WordPress page without another account/approval store.
Membership grants no blanket private-page role; anonymous page, REST, search and feed responses withhold protected content.
A routine publish action cannot make the configured member page public.
Withdrawing the FRRN approval closes WordPress access on the next request; explicit reapproval restores it.
The member can withhold membership while keeping their FRRN approval.
Disconnecting the site ends that WordPress identity session; native administrator access stays available.
Disabling the identity plugin leaves the actual WordPress page private.
